workflow: join sample, jurisdiction, license, matrix, custody, rule pack, panel, method, limit, scope, signer, and final COA identifiers
emit RELEASEABLE or HOLD with one stable reason code
write deterministic CSV, JSON, append-only evidence manifest, and human-readable exception report
record any override in a hash-linked ledger with named reviewer, reason, and timestamp
keep release as a separate named-human receipt without altering validation output
acceptance: 150 synthetic records across five jurisdiction and rule-pack fixtures
exactly five each RULE_VERSION_EXPIRED, PANEL_NOT_VALID_FOR_JURISDICTION, METHOD_LIMIT_MISMATCH, CUSTODY_GAP, DUPLICATE_RELEASE_ID, and SCOPE_OR_SIGNER_MISMATCH
repeat CSV, JSON, decision, exception, and evidence-manifest outputs are byte-identical
source and result hashes remain unchanged
override ledger requires named reviewer, reason, timestamp, and prior-entry hash
exclusions: no chemical interpretation, regulatory opinion, result alteration, accreditation decision, or autonomous COA release
no live interface, outreach, buyer data, storefront, payment action, or cash claim
